items.title: Botanicals

items.title: Trees
items.intro: Baobabs and acacias in charcoal, pencil and paint, from full silhouettes to close bark detail.

items.title: Faces
items.intro: Portraits of people in charcoal, pencil and paint.

items.title: Paintings
items.intro: Acrylic paintings on canvas, board and slate.
